svg.aria-label: SEO Agent: three agents run an SEO audit of yoursite.co.uk, fixing noindex, 404 errors, toxic links, slow LCP, thin content, missing schema, duplicate titles and low authority, while the site's position in Google climbs from 48 to 1.
